name: Flying Whales
description: Develops large-capacity cargo airships capable of transporting heavy and oversized loads to locations without conventional transport infrastructure. Its LCA60T airship is designed to carry up to 60 tonnes and load or unload cargo while hovering, targeting forestry, renewable energy, construction, and industrial logistics.
Investors: CMA CGM (lead), Carac, Air Liquide, Groupe ADP, Bouygues, Sogecap, French Tech Souveraineté, Temaris, Principality of Monaco, Nouvelle-Aquitaine Regional Government

name: Dougs
description: Develops an online accounting and business-management platform combining proprietary software, AI automation, and professional accountants. Its subscription services cover bookkeeping, tax filings, company formation, payroll, legal services, and electronic invoicing.
Investors: Expedition Growth Capital
Founder: Patrick Maurice, Véronique Maurice, Sarah Jaouani, Florent Galland

name: Epyr
description: Develops high-temperature thermal-energy storage systems that help industrial manufacturers replace fossil-fuel boilers with electric heat. Its technology uses inexpensive electricity to heat firebricks, storing energy for subsequent delivery as industrial steam. Also offers integrated deployment, energy management, and Heat-as-a-Service financing.
Investors: SlateVC, AENU, Daphni, OVNI Capital, WEPA Ventures, Aurum Impact

name: HyLight
Sectors: ClimateTech, Aerospace, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Energy
description: Develops autonomous, hydrogen-powered airships that inspect electricity networks, gas pipelines, and railway infrastructure. Its HyLighter aircraft collect high-resolution imagery and sensor data, which the company processes using AI to detect defects, identify methane leaks, and help infrastructure operators plan preventive maintenance.
Investors: Rubio Impact Ventures, DRW, Teampact Ventures, Y Combinator, Ring Capital
Founder: Martin Bocken, Josef Rokusek, Thomas Laporte

name: Goodweek
description: Develops a platform that allows SMEs to manage employee access to multiple AI models, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Mistral. It combines AI tools within a controlled environment where businesses can administer permissions, protect company data, and monitor spending.
Investors: Adara Ventures (lead), Anamcara Capital, BGV, BY Venture Partners, CentraleSupélec Venture, FJ Labs, Interlace Ventures, True Ventures

name: Wavo
description: Provides inventory financing for SMEs and mid-sized companies. Instead of issuing loans, Wavo temporarily purchases eligible stock and resells it to clients as they sell their products. Its technology analyzes inventory movements and financial information to assess financing eligibility and manage transactions.
Investors: Eurazeo (lead), Axeleo Capital, HUB612
Founder: Julien Decherf, Adrien Plat, Tanguy Clerget

name: Webyn
description: Develops an AI-powered conversion optimization platform that uses autonomous agents to analyze visitor behavior, test website improvements, and personalize e-commerce experiences in real time.
Investors: Réflexion Capital (lead), Tomcat, Business Angels

name: CarbonFarm
description: Develops technology and financing infrastructure to reduce methane emissions from rice cultivation. Its platform combines satellite imagery, AI, agricultural field data, and greenhouse-gas modeling to measure emissions, verify changes in farming practices, and support the certification of carbon-reduction projects.
Investors: Colam Impact (lead), Proparco, Suma Capital, elea, Working Capital Fund, Albo, Bpifrance, Serena, makesense, Technmind

name: Bruxless
description: Develops a wearable device intended to reduce nocturnal teeth grinding and jaw clenching. Its connected chin strap detects jaw muscle contractions and delivers calibrated mechanical stimulation to encourage muscle relaxation. Incorporates technology developed by parent company Techno Concept.
Investors: Undisclosed (family shareholders)

name: Koddex
description: Develops an Engineering Operating System for companies designing complex industrial products. Its platform connects product requirements, components, bills of materials, testing, engineering decisions, and certification evidence, replacing fragmented spreadsheets and disconnected engineering tools with a traceable information system.
Investors: Breega (lead), Exotec

name: H&B Materials
description: Develops bio-based, PFAS-free treatments that make textiles water-repellent without relying on conventional fluorinated coatings. Its patented technology chemically binds hydrophobic molecules to textile fibers and works with existing industrial finishing equipment.
Investors: Anima, Alpha Star, Keenest, RAISE Sherpas, Bpifrance, Caisse d'Épargne

name: Fibraterre
description: Manufactures low-carbon insulation panels made entirely from compressed wheat straw, without glue or synthetic resins. Its products provide thermal and acoustic insulation for new buildings and renovations.
Investors: UTC Alumni Invest, SideAngels, Normandie Participations, Bpifrance
Founder: Alain Le Berre, Gilles Froidure, Cédric Billard, Vincent Billaud

name: Logbook
description: Develops an AI-assisted audio-feedback platform that allows teachers to record spoken comments on student work. The software transcribes and analyzes the feedback, tracks progress by skill for each student, and helps teachers personalize instruction.
Investors: Time4 (daphni), makesense Seed II, Business Angels
Founder: Axelle Lhermitte, Mathieu Pichon, Benjamin Abdi

name: Lili for Life
description: Develops assistive reading devices for people with dyslexia. Its product range includes the Lili Lamp and a computer monitor that uses light-pulsing technology to improve reading comfort and reduce visual fatigue.
Investors: Undisclosed (existing shareholders)

name: UZAI
description: Develops an AI-powered platform for collecting, classifying, analyzing, and archiving evidence that trademarks are being used commercially. The software helps corporations and IP professionals document trademark use across jurisdictions, supporting enforcement, renewals, and legal proceedings. Operates as UZ.IP.
Investors: Paris Business Angels, HUB612, Business Angels
Founder: Julie Cahen, Julien Scicluna, Louis Stockreisser, Lieven Jacquot

name: MAGE-X Medical AI
description: Develops an AI-powered SaaS platform that automatically converts unstructured medical records, including clinical notes, surgical reports, and PDFs, into structured datasets, helping physicians, hospitals, and medical-device manufacturers conduct clinical research, track outcomes, and generate real-world evidence.
Investors: Healthcare professionals (undisclosed), Bpifrance
Founder: Augustin Missoffe, Hadrien Giorgi, Aymeric Faure, Marc Szadkowski, Henri d'Astorg, Alfred Butler

name: Spiko
description: Regulated cash-management platform that issues tokenized money-market funds and makes them accessible to businesses, individuals, and financial platforms through apps and APIs. Manages $2.7B in assets across funds denominated in four currencies.
Investors: New Enterprise Associates (lead), Index Ventures, Bpifrance, Speedinvest, Flourish Ventures, Shapers, White Star Capital, Blockwall, Frst, EQNX, Mirana Ventures, Wintermute Ventures, Business Angels, Axel Weber

name: Wiremind
description: Develops AI-powered revenue-management, inventory, distribution, and ticketing software for passenger transport, air cargo, sports, and live entertainment.
Investors: IronWave, Bpifrance, Seaya Andromeda

name: Vates
description: Develops open-source enterprise virtualization software, including XCP-ng and Xen Orchestra, offering organizations an alternative to VMware for managing virtual machines, infrastructure, backups, and data-center operations.
Investors: IRIS, Bpifrance
Founder: Olivier Lambert, Nithida Vialle, Julien Fontanet

name: WhiteLab Genomics
description: Uses AI and experimental validation to design and optimize delivery systems and programmable genetic payloads for genomic medicines, including viral vectors, lipid nanoparticles, and synthetic promoters.
Investors: AVP, Yaday Health, Blast Club, Omnes Capital, Debiopharm Innovation Fund
Founder: David Del Bourgo, Lucia Cinquem, Julien Cottineau

name: Rivercell
description: Develops proprietary biological-data infrastructure and AI models that predict how human cells respond to drugs and genetic modifications. Combines automated laboratory experiments, multimodal single-cell data, and AI world models to accelerate drug discovery. Formerly Blossom Life Sciences.
Investors: HV (lead), HCVC, Alven, Bpifrance, Business Angels

name: Vocca
Sectors: HealthTech, Artificial Intelligence, Voice AI, SaaS
description: Builds healthcare-specific AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, handle routine queries and administrative requests, and integrate with medical scheduling systems.
Investors: Norrsken, Heal Capital, Speedinvest, firstminute, Business Angels

name: VoltR
description: Remanufactures lithium batteries by recovering usable cells from end-of-first-life batteries, testing their residual performance and redeploying them into new made-in-France battery packs.
Investors: Bpifrance, Decathlon PULSE, France 2030
Founder: Alban Regnier, Maxime Bleskine, François Mallet, Thibaud Maufront

name: Edonia
description: Develops Edo, a minimally processed, high-protein food ingredient made from spirulina using its patented Edonization process, for food manufacturers and foodservice operators.
Investors: SWEN, Asterion Ventures, EIT Food, Bpifrance, France 2030
Founder: Hugo Valentin, Pierre Mignon, Nicolas Irlinger

name: Netsec
description: AI-native managed IT and cybersecurity platform that consolidates endpoint management, identity, networking, security operations, cloud infrastructure, and help-desk services, delivered through Slack and Microsoft Teams. Legal entity Barbican SAS.
Investors: Partech (lead), Primo Capital, View Different, Riccardo Zacconi, Kima Ventures, Ithaca Investments, Vento, Vito Lomele, Everywhere Ventures, Business Angels

name: Archeon Medical
description: Develops real-time ventilation-monitoring technology for emergency resuscitation. Its EOlife system measures ventilation delivered to cardiac-arrest patients and provides visual feedback to emergency responders, helping them avoid insufficient or excessive ventilation.
Investors: Newfund (lead), Eiffel Investment Group, UI Investissement, Majycc Innovation Santé, Karot Capital

name: Cleavr
description: AI-native accounts-receivable platform that automates invoice collection from post-invoicing through payment, including multichannel reminders, calls, dispute handling, payment matching, and escalation.
Investors: Varsity, Kima Ventures, Better Angle, 100IN, Portfolio Ventures, Kerala Ventures, Financière Saint James, Station F, Clover, Business Angels
Founder: Baptiste Nassoy, Arthur Guérin, Antoine Grenard

name: AlloBrain
description: Develops an AI platform for contact centers combining automated customer-service agents, real-time assistance for human operators, conversation analysis, and quality monitoring, with human oversight for sensitive decisions. Formerly AlloReview.
Investors: Varsity (lead), Groupama, Business Angels
Founder: Zied Haj-Yahia, Adrien Sasportes, Yves-Marie Bouedo

name: Verso
description: AI-powered consumer research platform that automates study design, participant recruitment, video and voice interviews, and qualitative analysis, using adaptive AI interviewers and building continuously updated consumer profiles and searchable knowledge bases.
Investors: Angular Ventures (lead), 100IN, Kima Ventures, Olympe Capital, Sharpstone Capital, Business Angels, Roxanne Varza, Hexa

name: Fleuret AI
description: Develops an agentic AI platform that automates penetration testing for web applications and APIs, continuously identifying vulnerabilities, proving exploitability, supporting remediation, and retesting fixes.
Investors: RAISE Ventures (lead), Auriga Cyber Ventures, Wind Capital, Better Angle, Business Angels, Jules Veyrat, Alexandre Andreini, Eric Fourrier, Georges Lotigier, Olivier Pantaleo, Jean-François Aliotti

name: VoltaBack
description: Software platform that uses connected-vehicle, electricity-meter, and tariff data to manage corporate fleets and reimburse employees for home EV charging without installing dedicated charging hardware.
Investors: Serena, Business Angels, Aurélien de Meaux, Maxime Brousse

name: Joe AI
description: Builds omnichannel AI agents for real-estate professionals that handle phone, email, SMS, WhatsApp and live-chat interactions and can execute actions directly inside property-management and other industry software.
Investors: Xplore, Plug and Play Ventures, Business Angels, Thierry Herrmann, Olivier Safar, Patrick Safar, Marc Menasé, Benjamin Chemla, Justine Cazalière, Rémy Sultan, Renaud Dalbera, Cyril Madar, Julien Madar, Bpifrance

name: Betty Care
description: Digital perioperative-care platform helping medical teams manage patient preparation before surgery, rehabilitation, outcomes reporting, and remote post-operative monitoring. Operated by AIMED2.
Investors: Undisclosed

name: V-Loc
description: Provides medium-term rentals of electric licence-free cars, typically for periods ranging from one to 12 months, targeting drivers including teenagers, seniors and people with suspended licences.
Investors: Undisclosed
Founder: Quentin Sabathé, Lucas Sabathé, Estelle Henny, Guillaume Gomanne

name: Combiné Kids
description: Develops screen-free, Wi-Fi-connected corded telephones for children aged 4-12. The device lets children make and receive calls without a smartphone, browser, or social media, while parents manage approved contacts, calling hours, and voicemail through a companion app. Operated by Dorim Group.
Investors: Business Angels, Kelly Massol, Alice Lhabouz, Angélique Gérard, Jérémy Bendayan

name: Doors3
description: Technology-transformation consultancy combining strategic consulting, software development, and creative services, specializing in artificial intelligence, blockchain, digital assets, and immersive technologies.
Investors: 9 Capital Management
Founder: Karen Jouve, Guillaume Moret-Bailly, Julien Furlanetto
